title: Display project identity colors in README documentation
abstract: Embed a project's assigned stable, perceptually distinguishable identity color in its README using a portable rendering such as SVG or CSS when suitable.

source.reference: Generalized project-management and strict-porting proposal; private drafting text not retained

scope_hints.trigger: maintaining a README for a project with a color identity
